conditions.coverage: native filesystem notifications and content verification only; no parsing, semantic invalidation, immutable publication, or UI
conditions.event_clock: watcher callback records arrival time; notifications may precede completion of the write
conditions.failure_policy: timeouts, watcher failures, and incorrect updates abort the run rather than being omitted from summaries
conditions.fixture: owned temporary directory; 100 files per directory; distinct file per operation; source repositories not modified
conditions.overflow: recovery deliberately discards one event; actual operating-system queue overflow is not induced
conditions.verification: fingerprint file after a candidate event, then update the mutable manifest; five-second deadline per operation
